cohort: Women who delivered at Gandhi Hospital in Telangana, India, between March 2021 and October 2021 and were referred within 42 days after delivery with fever and symptoms suggestive of puerperal infection.
finding: Out of 161 puerperal infection cases, Caesarean section was the mode of delivery for 56% of cases, and several comorbidities were commonly associated, with 19.2% of women dying, mostly due to multi-organ failure.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery for 56% of puerperal infection cases.
